name: htaccess Redirect Generator
summary: Generate Apache .htaccess redirects, HTTPS, and www rules — locally in your browser.
description: Add 301/302 (and related) redirects, optionally force HTTPS or www/apex hosts, and copy a ready-to-review .htaccess snippet. Always test on staging; Apache modules and hosts vary.

faqs.question: Will this work on Nginx?
faqs.answer: No. This outputs Apache .htaccess / mod_rewrite style rules. Nginx needs different config.

faqs.question: Should I paste this blindly into production?
faqs.answer: No. Review order of rules, existing config, and test redirects before deploying.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
